summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature. Changes: rich/segment.py adds ControlType.SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] member in the ControlCode union. rich/control.py adds the SET_WINDOW_TITLE formatter (ESC ] 0 ; title BEL) and the Control.title classmethod with an Args docstring. rich/console.py adds set_window_title(title) -> bool beside show_cursor, gated only on is_terminal, with a Google-style docstring. rich/_windows_renderer.py adds one elif branch that calls term.set_title(title) for title controls. CHANGELOG.md gets an Unreleased Added bullet linking pull request 2200. Tests added: test_control_title in tests/test_control.py, test_set_window_title in tests/test_console.py (skipped on Windows), and test_control_set_window_title in tests/test_windows_renderer.py (mocked wrapper). Not run: tests, mypy, and Black were not executed, per instructions, so nothing is verified by execution. Nothing committed. The changelog link uses https://github.com/Textualize/rich/pull/2200, inferred from the spec.
